_comment: Per-monitor override for the Acer (HDMI-A-1). Caelestia layers this on top of ../../shell.json for this screen only; DP-1 is untouched. Every key here must be a per-screen property (CONFIG_PROPERTY); anything the shell declares as CONFIG_GLOBAL_PROPERTY is global-only and will be ignored here.

background._comment: The wallpaper is still drawn here. Set this to false for a bare screen - it will then show Hyprland's misc:background_color, which is set to the scheme background in ~/.config/hypr/misc.lua.
